capabilities: roll over unchecked todos from the previous weekly note into the current one
trigger rollover via command palette, ribbon icon, or automatically on new note creation
roll todos into a chosen template heading or the end of the note
optionally delete rolled-over todos from the previous weekly note
undo the last rollover within two minutes
extras: Installation before official release requires the BRAT beta plugin installer. The undo command only works within a 2-minute window after rollover.
intentEvidence: Since the existing plugin only allows rollover of daily notes
motivation: The author prefers working with weekly notes because daily notes are too granular for their workflow, so they built a weekly variant of an existing daily-todos plugin.
problem: Existing rollover plugins only carry incomplete todos between daily notes, leaving users who plan around weekly notes without automated task rollover.

relations.evidence: It's heavily inspired from the  obsidian-rollover-daily-todos
You must have Periodic Notes plugin installed AND the Weekly Notes setting toggled on

summary: A weekly-note task rollover plugin that copies or moves unchecked todos from the previous weekly note into the current one.
